meta.name: The Young Pope 720p
meta.description: Lenny Belardo, the youngest and first American Pope in the history of the Church, must establish his new papacy and navigate the power struggles of the closed, secretive Vatican.

videos.title: First Episode (1)
videos.overview: Newly elected Pope Pius XIII, a.k.a. Lenny Belardo, defies Vatican expectations as he begins his reign.

videos.title: First Episode (2)
videos.overview: Lenny sets down the ground rules for his first speech at St. Peter's. Cardinal Spencer spurns an olive branch.

videos.title: Second Episode
videos.overview: After his inaugural speech makes it clear that he will not be manipulated, Lenny makes enemies within the Vatican. However, he gains one ardent follower.

videos.title: Third Episode
videos.overview: Believing that the only way to end Lenny's papacy is to involve him in a scandal, Cardinal Secretary of State Voiello blackmails Ester to seduce the pontiff.

videos.title: Fifth Episode
videos.overview: Nine months into Lenny's papacy, he gives his first audience to the Italian prime minister. Dussolier carries out a controversial edict.

videos.title: Sixth Episode
videos.overview: Dussollier blames himself after a tragedy and returns to Honduras. With Lenny's supporters dwindling, he questions whether his papacy is coming to an end.

videos.title: Seventh Episode
videos.overview: Reeling from a personal loss, Pope Pius XIII makes an impulsive decision to visit Africa, meeting a revered missionary who stirs mixed feelings inside him.

videos.title: Eighth Episode
videos.overview: Gutierrez is dejected by his failure to find evidence against Cardinal Kurtwell, but a new witness may be able to give him what he is looking for.

videos.title: Ninth Episode
videos.overview: Pope Pius XIII prepares to reveal himself publicly for the first time in a pastoral visit to Venice, but not before settling some scores.
